short_title: What phosphate rock and phosphogypsum contain (2018)
title: Characterization of phosphate rock and phosphogypsum from Gabes phosphate fertilizer factories (SE Tunisia): high mining potential and implications for environmental protection
summary: Analysed what phosphate rock and phosphogypsum are made of. Both carry a lot of trace elements. The authors estimate how much pollution flows to the sea each year and argue the waste could be processed again and reused instead of dumped.

findings.headline: Pollution flowing into the sea each year is estimated for each substance
findings.summary: The authors estimate how much of each pollutant from phosphogypsum reaches the sea every year. The amounts range from 0.05 tonnes (rhenium) to 87,249.60 tonnes (fluoride).
findings.headline_original: Yearly contaminant flows to the sea are estimated per substance
findings.summary_original: Estimated annual flows of phosphogypsum contaminants into the marine environment range from 0.05 t (rhenium) to 87,249.60 t (fluoride).

summary_original: Analysed the chemistry and minerals of phosphate rock and phosphogypsum. Both carry high loads of trace elements. The authors estimate yearly flows of contaminants to the sea and argue the waste could be reprocessed instead of dumped.
